title: story state add/remove silently deletes state descriptions from states.toml

description:
## What
`storage::save_states` silently deletes the `description` field of every state
in `.storyhook/states.toml`. `domain::StateDef` has no `description` field, so
the value is dropped at deserialize time and never written back out.

## Where
- `src/domain.rs` — `StateDef` (slug, super, role only)
- `src/storage.rs` — `save_states` / `add_state` / `remove_state`

## Extent
Any command that rewrites states.toml destroys all state descriptions in the
file: `story state add`, `story state remove`. This repo's own
`.storyhook/states.toml` carries two descriptions (in-progress, verifying) that
would be lost on the next `story state add`.

## Repro
1. `story init` in an empty dir
2. Append to `.storyhook/states.toml`:
   [[states]]
   slug = "review"
   super = "OPEN"
   description = "Waiting on a reviewer"
3. `story state add qa --super OPEN`
4. Re-read `.storyhook/states.toml` — the `description` line is gone.

Verified against v0.16.0.

## Last known good
None — `StateDef` has never had a description field. `TypeDef` does, which is
why types.toml is unaffected and states.toml looks like an oversight.

## Blocks
SH-41 (status-configuration UI), which writes states.toml from both UIs and
would make this data loss routine rather than rare.
